evidence: The API returns **at most five association detail records per target–disease pair**.
metric: associations(top: 5) at two query sites; observed counts 1-5, maximum 5; evidence_count == len(evidence) on every row; associationCount fetched but discarded
observation: The GraphQL queries request associations(top: 5), so at most five association detail rows are returned per target-disease pair. The API also returns associationCount, but the extractor fetches it and does not store it, and evidence_count is set to len(evidence), so the field name implies a total that the value does not carry.
subject: F-84
title: evidence_count is a capped detail count, not the release's association total
